caso.texto:
Bridge Services sent a requested proposal. The contact agreed follow-up after Friday's internal meeting, but automation scheduled daily messages. On Thursday the buyer asked for a pause until further notice. Another rep prepared a call. No genuine proposal expiry exists.

A Chicago buyer needs procurement feedback after a dated internal review. A calendar invitation must use America/Chicago for that date. Do not treat a seller's month-end forecast deadline as the buyer's deadline.

projeto.instrucoes: Create three sequences: new interest, pending proposal and permitted re-engagement. Correct this case with purpose, conditions and stopping rules for each step.
projeto.gabarito: Pause automation and update relevant owners. The later request changes the earlier follow-up agreement; Friday is no longer assumed permission. Do not invent expiry. Sequences require valid conditions and stop for refusal, mismatch or ended purpose.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
